[[Major/Legends|Major]] '''Drummond''' was the [[Warden/Legends|warden]] of [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Alpha TR-8]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rordak]]. He had previously served in the [[Politics/Legends|political]] detention wards on the planet [[Chromovon]].
